name: lsp
description: Language server tools help with code: they check types after edits (LspDiagnostics), find definitions and references, show signatures, and list symbols. Results come from the language server for the file, not text search. Elowen supports TypeScript, Pyright, gopls, rust-analyzer, clangd, and more. It can install npm-based servers in its own folder. Turning it off stops all servers and disables the tools.

configSchema.label: Live diagnostics
configSchema.hint: Check edits with language servers. Turning this off stops all running servers. The tools stay listed but report that LSP is off. The `/lsp` command switches the same setting.

configSchema.label: How long to keep servers running
configSchema.hint: How long a language server with no check in flight stays ready for the next one. Each warm server keeps its project index in memory, so this is memory against the ~15 second restart. 0 keeps servers until the pool fills or LSP is turned off; a server whose project directory was deleted is released either way. In a managed Project a guest session is also bounded at 15 minutes by the privileged worker, so a server there is replaced at least that often however this is set.
